  | WHERE
      event_name == "app.crash" AND
        exception.stacktrace IS NOT NULL
  | KEEP exception.stacktrace
  | LIMIT 1
  | EVAL frame = SPLIT(exception.stacktrace, "\n")
  | MV_EXPAND frame
  | EVAL frame = TRIM(frame)
  | WHERE LENGTH(frame) > 0
  | DISSECT
      frame
      "at %{obfuscated_method_call}(%{source_info})"
  | DISSECT source_info "%{?skip}:%{obf_line_str}"
  | EVAL obf_line = COALESCE(TO_INTEGER(obf_line_str), 0)
  | LOOKUP JOIN android-r8-mappings
        ON obfuscated_method_call
  | EVAL
      _sentinel =
        CONCAT(
          TO_STRING(obf_line),
          "|",
          TO_STRING(obf_line),
          "|0|0|__UNMAPPED__|")
  | EVAL mappings = COALESCE(mappings, _sentinel)
  | MV_EXPAND mappings
  | DISSECT
      mappings
      "%{range_start}|%{range_end}|%{orig_start}|%{orig_end}|%{original_call}|%{r8_extras}"
  | EVAL
      range_start_i = TO_INTEGER(range_start),
      range_end_i = TO_INTEGER(range_end)
  | WHERE
      obf_line >= range_start_i AND
        obf_line <= range_end_i
  | EVAL
      orig_start_i = TO_INTEGER(orig_start),
      orig_end_i = TO_INTEGER(orig_end)
  | EVAL
      original_line =
        CASE(orig_start_i == orig_end_i, orig_start_i,
          orig_start_i + obf_line - range_start_i)
  | EVAL
      deobfuscated_frame =
        CASE(
          original_call == "__UNMAPPED__",
          CASE(frame LIKE "at *", CONCAT("\t", frame),
            frame),
          CONCAT(
            "\tat ",
            LEFT(
              original_call,
              LENGTH(original_call) - 1),
            ":",
            TO_STRING(original_line),
            ")"))
  | STATS frames = VALUES(deobfuscated_frame)
  | EVAL stacktrace = MV_CONCAT(frames, "\n")
  | KEEP stacktrace"},"columns":[{"columnId":"stacktrace","fieldName":"stacktrace","label":"Deobfuscated Stacktrace","customLabel":true,"meta":{"type":"string","esType":"keyword"},"inMetricDimension":true}],"timeField":"@timestamp"}},"indexPatternRefs":[{"id":"db1b82118f911c56ba44097976150905e151140dd56064462de8b403fc7f580e","title":"logs-generic.otel*","timeField":"@timestamp"}]}},"filters":[],"query":{"esql":"FROM logs-generic.otel*
